title: When I was a child
goal: Form the imparfait of any verb and say where you lived and what you used to do as a child.

drills.text: Quand j'étais petit, je ___ au soccer tous les jours. (jouer)
drills.en: When I was little, I used to play soccer every day.
We used to speak Arabic at home.
My parents used to work a lot.
drills.explain: ils / elles → -aient. The ending is silent: it sounds like travaillait.

drills.prompt: We used to live in a village.
drills.explain: nous → habitions; with on, use the il form: on habitait.

items.en: être in the imparfait (the only irregular stem: ét-)

drills.prompt: Which is the imparfait stem of être?
drills.explain: Être is the one exception: its stem is ét-, not the nous form (sommes).

drills.text: Le dimanche, je ___ chez mes grands-parents. (manger)
drills.en: On Sundays, I used to eat at my grandparents' place.
drills.explain: Keep the e before -a: mangeais, so the g stays soft.

drills.en: School used to start at eight.
drills.explain: ç before -a keeps the s sound: commençait.

drills.en: We used to travel every summer.
drills.explain: Before -i, no extra e is needed: nous voyagions.

items.note: Like finir: nous grandissons → je grandissais.

example.fr: J'ai passé mon enfance à Sousse.
example.en: I spent my childhood in Sousse.

example.fr: Mes grands-parents habitaient à la campagne.
example.en: My grandparents lived in the countryside.

items.note: In Québec people also just say le primaire.

blocks.title: Coffee break at work in Québec City
blocks.context: Lucie asks her new colleague Karim about his childhood.

lines.speaker: Lucie
lines.fr: Dis, Karim, tu as grandi où ?
lines.en: Say, Karim, where did you grow up?

lines.speaker: Karim
lines.fr: En Tunisie, dans un petit village près de Sousse. Quand j'étais petit, j'habitais avec mes parents et mes grands-parents.
lines.en: In Tunisia, in a small village near Sousse. When I was little, I lived with my parents and my grandparents.

lines.speaker: Lucie
lines.fr: Une grande famille ! Et tu allais à l'école comment ?
lines.en: A big family! And how did you get to school?

lines.speaker: Karim
lines.fr: À pied. L'école primaire était à cinq minutes de la maison. Après l'école, je jouais dehors avec mes cousins jusqu'au soir.
lines.en: On foot. The elementary school was five minutes from the house. After school, I played outside with my cousins until the evening.

lines.speaker: Lucie
lines.fr: Moi, j'ai grandi à Chicoutimi. L'hiver, nous jouions au hockey dehors, sur le lac.
lines.en: I grew up in Chicoutimi. In winter, we used to play hockey outside, on the lake.

lines.speaker: Karim
lines.fr: Au hockey, bien sûr ! Et l'été ?
lines.en: Hockey, of course! And in summer?

lines.speaker: Lucie
lines.fr: Chaque été, nous allions au chalet de mes grands-parents. Et toi ?
lines.en: Every summer, we used to go to my grandparents' cottage. What about you?

lines.speaker: Karim
lines.fr: Nous, nous allions à la plage. Et nous mangions beaucoup de poisson !
lines.en: We used to go to the beach. And we ate a lot of fish!

lines.speaker: Lucie
lines.fr: Et à la maison, vous parliez quelle langue ?
lines.en: And at home, what language did you speak?

lines.speaker: Karim
lines.fr: Nous parlions arabe à la maison et français à l'école. Mon grand-père lisait le journal en français tous les matins.
lines.en: We spoke Arabic at home and French at school. My grandfather read the newspaper in French every morning.

blocks.body: Listen first. Notice the many verbs ending in **-ais, -ait, -ions, -iez**: [[j'habitais]], [[je jouais]], [[nous allions]], [[vous parliez]]. That is the **imparfait**, the tense for *what life was like* and *what you used to do*. Lucie also says [[tu as grandi]] and [[j'ai grandi]]: that is the passé composé you already know.

blocks.title: What the imparfait is for
blocks.body:
The **imparfait** describes the past as an ongoing situation, not as a finished event. In English it often matches **used to**, **would** (for habits) or **was / were + -ing**:

- [[Je jouais dehors.]] I used to play outside. / I was playing outside.
- [[Nous allions à la plage.]] We would go to the beach.
- [[L'école était près de la maison.]] The school was near the house.

The **passé composé** (unit 1 and 2) tells what happened, one finished event: [[J'ai grandi en Tunisie.]] [[Hier, j'ai joué au soccer.]] You will learn to combine the two tenses in unit 10. For now, use the imparfait to paint a picture of your childhood.

blocks.title: Two steps to form it
blocks.note: Take the **nous** form of the present, remove **-ons**, and add the endings. This works for almost every verb, regular or not.

examples.en: we speak → I used to speak
we finish → I used to finish
we take → I used to take
we do → I used to do

blocks.title: From the nous form to the stem
head: infinitive
nous (present)
imparfait stem
je / j' (imparfait)
blocks.note: **Être** is the only exception: its stem is **ét-**. Everything else follows the nous rule, even irregular verbs like [[faire]], [[prendre]] and [[aller]].

blocks.title: All the forms: parler and être
head: parler
être
blocks.note: Good news for listening: [[parlais]], [[parlait]] and [[parlaient]] sound **exactly the same**. Only [[nous parlions]] and [[vous parliez]] sound different.

blocks.title: Spelling: -ger, -cer and -ier verbs
blocks.body:
The endings are regular, but a few spellings protect the sound:

- **-ger verbs** keep an **e** before **a**: [[manger → je mangeais, ils mangeaient]], but [[nous mangions, vous mangiez]] (no e before i).
- **-cer verbs** take **ç** before **a**: [[commencer → je commençais, elle commençait]], but [[nous commencions]].
- **-ier verbs** get two i's with nous and vous: [[étudier → nous étudiions, vous étudiiez]]. It looks strange, but it is correct: stem [[étudi-]] + [[-ions]].

blocks.title: Why the nous form?
blocks.body: The nous form of the present is the most "regular" base of a verb: it shows the full stem, including the extra **-ss-** of [[finir]] ([[nous finissons]]) and the changed stem of [[faire]] ([[nous faisons]]). Once you know the present well, you already know almost the whole imparfait. That is why it is often called the easiest past tense in French.

- **Être from sommes:** [[nous sommions]] does not exist. Say [[nous étions]].
- **Forgetting the i:** [[nous parlons]] is the present; the imparfait is [[nous parlions]].
- **Élision:** [[je étais]] → [[j'étais]], [[je habitais]] → [[j'habitais]], [[je allais]] → [[j'allais]].
- **-ger verbs:** [[je mangais]] → [[je mangeais]].
- **Pronouncing -aient:** in [[ils jouaient]] the -ent is silent. Don't say a final *-ent* or *-ant*.
- **Translating “would”:** for a past habit, English *would* is the imparfait, not a conditional: *Every summer we would go to the beach* = [[Chaque été, nous allions à la plage.]]

blocks.title: School words in Québec and France
blocks.body:
Talking about your childhood means talking about school, and the words differ:

- **Québec:** [[le primaire]] (elementary, 6 years), [[le secondaire]] (high school, 5 years), then [[le cégep]] (a college between high school and university).
- **France:** [[l'école primaire]], [[le collège]] (middle school), [[le lycée]] (high school).

Careful: in Québec, [[le collège]] usually means a cégep or a private school, not a middle school. Lucie's [[chalet]] is also very Québécois: a cottage, often by a lake.

blocks.title: Listen and repeat
blocks.note: The endings -ais, -ait, -aient all sound like the **è** in [[mère]].

lines.fr: Quand j'étais petit, j'habitais à la campagne.
lines.en: When I was little, I lived in the countryside.
lines.tip: j'étais and j'habitais end with the same open è sound.

lines.fr: Je jouais dehors avec mes cousins.
lines.en: I used to play outside with my cousins.
lines.tip: jouais is one quick syllable, like “zhweh”.

lines.en: We used to go to the beach.
lines.tip: allions has a y sound: a-lyon.

blocks.fr: Nous parlions arabe à la maison.
blocks.en: We used to speak Arabic at home.
blocks.prompt: When is the speaker talking about?
blocks.explain: [[parlions]] has a *y* sound before the nasal *on*: that is the imparfait. The present [[parlons]] has no *y*.

blocks.fr: Le samedi, je joue au hockey avec mes enfants.
blocks.en: On Saturdays, I play hockey with my kids.
blocks.prompt: When is the speaker talking about?
blocks.explain: [[je joue]] ends in an *ou* sound: present. The imparfait [[je jouais]] ends in *è*.

steps.title: Your turn
steps.intro: Find the nous form in your head first, then add the ending.

blocks.text: Quand j'étais petite, j'___ à Casablanca. (habiter)
blocks.en: When I was little, I lived in Casablanca.

blocks.prompt: What is the imparfait stem of finir?
optionFeedback: Start from the nous form: nous finissons, with -ss-.
The infinitive is the base of the future, not of the imparfait.

blocks.text: Nous ___ à l'école à pied et nous ___ à la maison à midi. (aller, rentrer)
blocks.en: We used to walk to school and come home at noon.
blocks.explain: nous allons → all- + -ions; nous rentrons → rentr- + -ions.

blocks.prompt: Match each form to its meaning.
pairs: you used to go (formal or plural)

blocks.text: Le soir, je ___ mes devoirs avec mon frère. (faire)
blocks.en: In the evening, I used to do my homework with my brother.
blocks.explain: nous faisons → fais- → je faisais. [[Les devoirs]] = homework.

blocks.prompt: My grandparents used to live in the countryside.
accept: Mes grands-parents habitaient à la campagne.
Mes grands-parents vivaient à la campagne.
blocks.explain: [[habitaient]]: ils/elles take -aient. [[À la campagne]] = in the countryside.

blocks.text: Le dimanche, je ___ chez ma tante. (manger)
blocks.en: On Sundays, I used to eat at my aunt's.
blocks.explain: Keep the e before a: mangeais. [[mangeait]] is the il/elle form.

blocks.text: Je ___ né en Tunisie et j'___ dans un petit village.
blocks.en: I was born in Tunisia and I lived in a small village.
blocks.explain: Being born is a single event: passé composé with être, [[je suis né]]. Where you lived as a child is a description: imparfait, [[j'habitais]].

blocks.prompt: When I was little, I played outside. (man speaking)
accept: Quand j'étais petit, je jouais dehors.
Je jouais dehors quand j'étais petit.
blocks.explain: Two imparfaits: a description ([[j'étais petit]]) and a habit ([[je jouais]]).
ils/elles → -aient, with a silent ending. [[travailler]] keeps its -ill-: [[travaillaient]].

blocks.prompt: A colleague asks: “Tu as grandi où ?” Answer in about 40 seconds: where you lived, who you lived with, how you went to school, and what you used to do after school or in summer.
checklist: After school or in summer: je jouais / nous allions…
A language: À la maison, nous parlions…

models.label: Model answer
models.fr: J'ai grandi au Vietnam, à Hué. Quand j'étais petite, j'habitais avec mes parents et ma sœur dans une petite maison. J'allais à l'école à vélo. Après l'école, je jouais dehors avec mes amis. Chaque été, nous allions chez mes grands-parents, à la campagne. À la maison, nous parlions vietnamien, bien sûr.
models.en: I grew up in Vietnam, in Hué. When I was little, I lived with my parents and my sister in a small house. I went to school by bike. After school, I played outside with my friends. Every summer, we went to my grandparents' place in the countryside. At home, we spoke Vietnamese, of course.

blocks.prompt: Write a short paragraph for your French class: “Quand j'étais petit / petite…”. Say where you lived, describe your school, and give two things you used to do (after school, on weekends or in summer).
checklist: Start with Quand j'étais petit / petite
At least four verbs in the imparfait
One time expression: chaque été, le dimanche, après l'école

models.label: Model answer
models.fr: Quand j'étais petit, j'habitais à Pune, en Inde. Mon école était grande et elle commençait à huit heures. J'allais à l'école en bus avec ma sœur. Après l'école, je jouais au cricket dehors avec mes amis. Le dimanche, nous mangions chez mes grands-parents. Ma grand-mère faisait toujours un grand repas.
models.en: When I was little, I lived in Pune, India. My school was big and it started at eight. I went to school by bus with my sister. After school, I played cricket outside with my friends. On Sundays, we ate at my grandparents' place. My grandmother always made a big meal.

summary:
- Form the **imparfait**: nous form − ons + [[-ais, -ais, -ait, -ions, -iez, -aient]]
- Remember the one exception: **être → ét-** ([[j'étais]]), and spellings like [[je mangeais]], [[je commençais]]
- Say where you grew up and what you used to do: [[Quand j'étais petit, j'habitais… je jouais…]]
